findings.title: Internal search pages are indexable, sitemap-listed and canonicalize to home
findings.evidence: The three base resource-search pages emit index/follow, inherit homepage canonical and homepage hreflang, reuse a resource index title and have no H1. All three appear in sitemap.xml. Query-result variants were deliberately not expanded.
findings.business_impact: Unrelated consolidation and public indexing signals disagree. This is not proof of large-scale search-result index bloat.
findings.recommended_fix: Choose an explicit internal-search indexing policy. Usually noindex the search UI/results and remove them from sitemap; keep crawler access to see noindex and preserve category/article links. Give the page a useful main heading for users. Do not indiscriminately robots-block the pages before Google can read exclusion directives.

findings.title: Curate tag landing pages before expanding the indexable archive set
findings.template_or_page: Known tag template across three languages; opportunity, not a defect count
findings.evidence: 267 known tag pages (89 per language) serve 35 articles per language. Many archives consist mostly of labels/cards. Their existence and length alone do not prove low quality, index bloat, doorway behavior or a penalty. Actual Google index/query data is unavailable.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod is a fixed June date despite later release content

findings.business_impact: Misrepresents significant updates on at least the release/changelog pages; does not prove all99 pages changed after June4 or that Google penalized the site.

findings.title: GST guide repeats superseded and overgeneralized guidance
findings.evidence: English guide states TCS 1%, marketplace registration mandatory regardless of turnover, and apparel above ₹1,000 taxed at 12%. Translated equivalents repeat substantive guidance. Official records document the 2024 TCS reduction and conditional ecommerce registration exemption; 2025 rate changes include a ₹2,500 apparel threshold. The claimed June 2026 update did not remove these conflicts. All tax obligations were not exhaustively re-adjudicated.
findings.business_impact: Merchants may rely on materially misleading compliance advice. This is a high-priority accuracy/trust issue independent of SEO rankings.
findings.recommended_fix: Have a qualified tax reviewer resolve every threshold/rate/exemption/filing statement against applicable current notifications and conditions. Correct all languages, include dated primary references and real reviewer attribution, then review related launch/invoice/payment guides. Do not replace one blanket rule with another. A GSTR-2A mention alone is not an error: official portal help describes TCS details in Part C.
findings.effort: 1–3 reviewer/editor days for guide family; assumes access to current notifications and native-language review
findings.dependencies: Current applicable notifications, actual jurisdiction/product facts and real review ownership.
findings.validation_steps: Maintain a claim-to-source ledger with effective dates, exceptions and reviewer signoff. Recheck all three language variants, article/card metadata, linked guides and update dates.
findings.success_indicator: Zero unresolved documented conflicts in the reviewed guide family; every material compliance claim has an applicable dated primary source.
findings.implementation_example: See IMPLEMENTATION-BRIEFS.md and existing source authority; no paste-ready business facts invented.

findings.title: Quantified article claims lack traceable in-body references
findings.confidence: High for missing references; truth of most figures unverified
findings.template_or_page: 19 English article pages; related translations require synchronized review
findings.evidence: Within all 35 English articles, body-container extraction finds no external reference anchors. 19 English articles contain percentage-pattern claims. Examples include exact payment shares/performance gains and growth/retention statistics. UPI guide also makes categorical zero-failure, fee and settlement assertions. Absence of citations does not prove every claim false; current fee and other factual applicability remain unverified.
findings.business_impact: Material numerical and financial assertions are difficult for readers or reviewers to verify; generic nationwide claims can be misapplied to a merchant.
findings.recommended_fix: Build a source ledger for each material figure/categorical assertion: exact statement, source URL, date, sample/population, metric definition, scope and review owner. Cite primary sources beside claims, qualify estimates and remove unsupported guarantees. Distinguish national payment volume from ecommerce share, transfer confirmation from merchant settlement, and RTO from customer returns. Add safe link/citation capability to the existing content contract/renderer when needed.
